select_prm.title: Select meter
select_prm.description: Your token grants access to multiple meters. Select the one you want to configure.

reconfigure.title: Replace the Linky token
reconfigure.description: Enter a new token from [{conso_url}]({conso_url}) for meter {prm}.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Linky
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new token from [{conso_url}]({conso_url}) for meter {prm}.

error.invalid_token: The token is invalid or expired
error.prm_access_denied: This token does not grant access to this meter
error.cannot_connect: The Conso API request failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.provider_forbidden: Conso API refused the request (HTTP 403). The submitted token was not saved. If it keeps happening, check the Home Assistant logs.
error.conso_budget_exhausted: No request was sent. Wait until the initial 24-hour pause, meter request limit, or Conso cooldown has ended.
error.conso_budget_unavailable: No request was sent because Home Assistant could not verify the Conso request budget. Check the logs.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The token for this meter was updated.
abort.reauth_successful: The token for this meter was updated.

data_description.collect_export: Enable if this meter measures electricity sent to the grid. Also applies to historical imports.
data_description.daily_only: Enable if the Enedis load curve is unavailable. Energy will only receive daily totals.

import_historical_data.name: Import historical data
import_historical_data.description: Import up to seven days of readings. Requests count toward the meter's request limit.

config_entry_id.name: Linky meter
config_entry_id.description: Select the Linky meter whose historical data to import.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Stop before this day (exclusive). Defaults to today in Europe/Paris.

conso_forbidden.title: Linky refresh refused (meter ending in {meter})
conso_forbidden.description: Conso API returned HTTP 403 on two consecutive consumption refreshes. The status alone does not identify the cause. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
